context: Review an upgrade to Collector Contrib 0.160. Current Kafka exporter uses auth.tls, top-level topic and encoding, and producer.required_acks: wait_for_all. k8s_attributes has deployment_name_from_replicaset: false. The Prometheus exporter promotes every resource attribute, including session.id. Explain required edits and what to validate before rollout.

checklist.name: Identifies startup-breaking Kafka settings
checklist.description: Moves tls to component level, topic/encoding under traces (or the selected signal), and uses numeric required_acks -1 for all in-sync replicas. Does not propose Kafka as a required new dependency.

checklist.name: Removes rejected Kubernetes setting
checklist.description: Removes deployment_name_from_replicaset entirely, including false, and explains that unknown keys prevent startup.

checklist.name: Restricts resource labels
checklist.description: Uses resource_constant_labels.included with explicit bounded attributes for 0.160, excludes session/user identifiers, and checks preexisting datapoint dimensions and producer identity.

checklist.name: Validates release-specific behavior
checklist.description: Validates rendered config with the target binary and checks changed Kubernetes metrics/alerts, storage and network reachability. Distinguishes config validation from end-to-end delivery; Go 1.26 applies to custom builds.
